name: bellteam-lattice-module
description: Child-only dependencies of the lattice module payload (docs/architecture/modules/runtime/lattice-child.md). @quolu/lattice 0.85.5 is the minimum: the first release with todo display read/source. 0.86.0 adds todo add (one task) for seats; 0.86.1 stops witness prompts on conversation plans; 0.87.0 adds todo independence witness declare (one task's row); 0.88.0 refuses a missing or blank design_memo (DESIGN_MEMO_REQUIRED) and adds opt-in enforced plans; 0.89.0 reports a value written by a newer Lattice as UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA (newer_lattice_value) instead of STORE_CORRUPT and adds --message to done hints on enforced plans; 0.90.0 lets witness declare record a row on a Store root with no commit (the chart dirs are git init without a commit), so enforced plans can start there, and adds startable notices (mutation result notices, todo notice list|ack); 0.91.0 accepts or rejects a phase with --message (evidence as text, no file in the Store root), so heavy phases of enforced plans can close on chart dirs without a commit; 0.92.0 adds todo wait (waiting marks on notices: waiting, waiting_digest, acked_recipients; ack set v2, v1 still reads), so the module can wake the Bots waiting on a task; 0.93.0 anchors evidence blobs under refs/lattice/evidence/<oid> so git gc keeps them (todo evidence anchor for evidence written before); 0.94.0 answers STORE_UNINITIALIZED (todo evidence anchor: exit 0, lattice.todo_evidence_anchor_uninitialized.v1) on a chart dir with no Store instead of STORE_INCONSISTENT; 0.95.0 adds todo nudge (read-only ready set per lane with fire/stop actions and a prompt) and answers STORE_UNINITIALIZED on the display reads too (display source exits 0 with project_id null); 0.96.0 adds todo blockers (read-only list of every stop on a chart); 0.97.0 lets any seat retract an in-progress task and reopen a done one (a journal with a reopen is unreadable to older Lattice: never downgrade below 0.97.0); 0.97.1 keeps a stop's time and actor in todo blockers across a plan revise (same shape).
